profile.headline: Application Developer at Woolpert
profile.summary: Experienced Application Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the civil engineering industry. Skilled in databases, .NET, and Angular. Engineering professional with a M.S. focused in Computer Engineering from the University of Cincinnati.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and supported mobile airfield inspection and electronic logging system (ELS) software. Integrations that include the FAA DNOTAM system, FAA Wildlife Strike Database, and safety management system (SMS).  Responsible for client engagement, task prioritization, requirement gathering, and coordination.

Developed enhanced re-write of Woolpert's SmartView Connect application front-end, a quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) tracking application used to review preliminary imagery, elevation and remote sensing data sets. Created tools to enable user application management in addition to further streamlining Woolpert’s image processing pipeline.

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description:
Developed software and enhancements for airport gate management, bag belt interfaces, ticket counter interfaces, chart visualization, data logging, mobile field inspection tools utilizing GPS and GIS, and Windows services.  Collaborative work environment providing many individually managed projects and frequent deadlines.  Gained experience in database design and programming, web applications and services, rich internet applications and enterprise applications.

Frequently used tools included Visual Studio and SQL Management Studio for projects written with C#, VB.NET, VB6, and JavaScript.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Software development for internal and client purposes.  Projects included a gate management system, ticket counter scheduling, application to provide gate status to flight information display systems (FIDS), application to provide bag status to bag belt displays, electronic logging system, and mobile airfield inspection software.

positions.title: Editor
positions.description: Wrote and edited articles; posted and edited news; and helped design and maintain the PHP/MySQL backend of the web site and forum.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Assisted with lab work to characterize ASICs and prototype system hardware involving the collection, post-processing and analysis of data.  Developed Forth scripts and hardware circuits to assist with power characterization of prototype systems.
